consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1994-03-30 show at The Omni was a standout performance for the year, highlighted by a strong second set featuring a memorable Scarlet > Fire > Playin' > Dark Star sequence. Many reviewers noted the emotional impact of the final Dark Star and praised Jerry's playing, despite some acknowledging occasional sloppiness.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 61 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans celebrated the show as one of the best of 1994, there were notable criticisms regarding performance consistency and some songs being less impactful, leading to a mixed overall sentiment.
